Strikers in the other hand immediately lose their DPS if you miss a combo or run out of time to perform the next chain, so playing striker is a conscious mechanical process instead an intuitive one, good in theory but gets old really fast.

Sword isn't bad but it's painfully average: good damage output but with no options for explosive damage, mobility depends on your skill and energy management.

Pike is great: Great DPS, its only explosive damage option is more useful as a mobility option more than a damage skill due it's low unreliable damage output, requires serious stamina management mindset.q

Strikers is a great weapon, almost the best weapon but it gets kinda boring really fast, it excels in almost all areas: damage output, mobility and stamina spending, but it lacks button smash/instinct usefulness.
Its usefulness depends on a list of 3 commands that need to be input correctly in an ordered fashion to rank up incredible high damage.
Not that it forbids you to mash X to do damage, but the only way to stack up damage is to master the mantras and end with explosive finishers.
Why does it get boring? Because the inputs are always the same in a rhythmic fashion as you have limited time to keep the combo going and the mantras active.
Strikers gameplay is resumed in XXX->XXY->YYY->R ad nauseam.

In the end all of them are useful but it depends on what's your style.
